behavior: A payer-chooses invoice doesn't close before every option chain was read past its close, so a paid one never shows expired
acceptance: While no option is chosen, the main row of a payer-chooses invoice expires only after every other enabled option chain was read past expires_at, and waits for the R-119 choice when any option has money; so an on-time payment on another option is always recorded and chosen first
The pay and owner pages (ClosedSQL, R-77) follow the same rule, so they don't show expired while that wait lasts
The choice query uses an index (id = $1 OR main_id = $1), not coalesce(main_id, id) = $1, since it runs for more rows

Tests cover both orders: the payment recorded before the main row is processed, and the main chain read past the close before the option chain records an on-time payment; neither paid invoice gets invoice.expired in its history; unit passes
notes: 2026-10-22 start from the patch kept from F266's review round: TestMainRowWaitsForTheChoiceBeforeExpiring and the newOptionSim helper in options_test.go cover the first order

2026-10-22 test recipe (sim, main on chain 1 and one option on chain 2, both close at 5000): order A: scanned(1,4800), option paid at 4900, scanned(2,4950), process(option) waits, scanned(1,5100), process(main), process(option); order B: scanned(2,4800), scanned(1,5100), process(main), then option paid at 4900, scanned(2,5100), process(option). Both: option paid, history [payer.option_chosen, invoice.paid, invoice.settlement_queued]

Also fix: dropping 'invoices.chosen_id IS NULL AND' from ClosedSQL fails no test (add an after-the-choice check); the old R-119 test comment is left above the optionSim type (options_test.go:149-152); money-safety.md's accepted risk and openapi Invoice.closed don't say a stopped option chain now also holds expiry of unpaid invoices; and R-119's 'no page calls it expired while any option holds a payment made on time' is wrong for a partial on-time payment.

2026-10-22 review pass by reviewer: Ledger choice-for-every-row, close gate and ClosedSQL are correct: no money left unbooked or misbooked, choice set once, late money held, superseded rows and expired partials unchanged, lock order unchanged, new queries use id/main_id indexes (EXPLAIN); each mutant (anyTransfer guard, close gate, chosen_id IS NULL in ClosedSQL) fails a test; the 5 packages pass with -race.
